items.quote: And when the children of Israel saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was.
items.claim: The text says the Israelites saw an unfamiliar substance, did not know what it was, and said to one another 'It is manna'.
items.mechanism: The text presents the name as coming from the people's uncertainty ('for they wist not what it was').

items.quote: And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which the LORD hath given you to eat.
items.claim: The text says Moses told the Israelites the substance was bread the LORD had given them to eat.
items.action: identified the substance as food given by God
items.mechanism: Moses gives a religious reason for the food: the LORD provided it.
